palette: newsprint gray + carbon + review saffron + disposition teal + remand crimson
typography: editorial headline crops, margin issue labels, narrow appellate bands, and dispositive end marks
composition: a first-instance record passes through an appellate prism that narrows issues, routes new matters, and fans into dispositions
surface: open newsprint columns, hard crop marks, translucent review bands, and no rounded cards or table grid
motion: only appealed issues enter the review band; remanded records return once and withdrawal paths visibly alter the first judgment
transition: the same first-instance judgment strip is cropped, refracted, returned, or made effective across scenes
